scope: Research-tool consolidation for selected plain R13/R14/R2000 DICTIONARY frames and observed R13/R14 type-500 DICTIONARYWDFLT frames; no library parser or encoder changes.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.1 and 20.4.44; selected source and synthetic controls do not resolve native cloning semantics.
checks: The shared walker bounds the frame, checks its version, unique traced identity, object size and CRC, then checks the version-specific dictionary body, EED, handle roles, names and alignment.

Six locally generated R13, R14 and R2000 inputs from independent runs produced identical DWG hashes and identical wire observations before and after the consolidation, including cloning 0 and 1 controls.

Additional locally generated populated R14 and R2000 dictionaries each retain the three expected names and soft-owner handles; the walker observes the R14 cloning field absent and the R2000 field equal to 1. Their frame bodies are included in the fast controls, with wrong-role and corrected-retry checks for each version.

Locally authored seeds were converted and reopened by ODA 27.1.0 as R13/R14 witnesses. The shared subclass walker reproduces the previous selected DICTIONARYWDFLT frame offsets, EED, cloning, owner, extension, item and default handles exactly; focused controls reject wrong roles and truncation before corrected retry.

The malformed-source generator also reuses the shared frame locator. Before and after the refactor, its R14 dictionary, CELLSTYLEMAP and default-role mutations have identical bytes and pass the same rejection/retry checks against the recorded earlier candidate binary; these are not current-head platform qualification.

The generated AC1012 two-element pair's populated root audit is byte-for-byte identical before and after the consolidation, including wrong-role rejection and corrected retry. The selected entity audit also passes.

The new fast CTest covers the three version profiles, wrong-version layout, malformed CRC, size, truncation and duplicate trace, wrong parent, extension and item roles, model mismatch and valid retry.
No generated drawing is committed; source-release inventory and self-test pass.
limits: The subclass path covers the selected observed type-500 R13/R14 DICTIONARYWDFLT frames; it does not establish class IDs or subclass layouts for arbitrary sources or other versions.
This refactor does not qualify native AutoCAD opening, duplicate-record merge behavior, legacy strict output, whole-source graph closure or general DWG support.
